name: Block Beast
detailed_description:
In Block Beast, you don't build out a team of units, instead, you build just a single Beast, using different Blocks with unique abilities.
- What happens if you put Kangaroo legs on your Beast, and it starts jumping into the sky? 
- Or equip a Dinosaur head that causes your beast to charge forward with rage, chomping at enemies!
- How about a fist that pounds the ground sending out shockwaves?
- Or you could attach a hard shell that reflects enemy projectiles right back at them!

Block Beast is a one-of-a-kind Auto-Battler experience!
Collect dozens of unique blocks, and build the strongest Beast ever.

= ENVIRONMENTAL TRAPS & HAZARDS =
Watch Out! In addition to customizing Beasts, players can also equip the arena with dangerous Traps & Hazards that unleash devastating damage.

= LOOT DROPS & CARE PACKAGES =
Looking to be less destructive? Players can also choose to trigger Loot Drops & Care Packages that will support their Beast during combat. 

= ASYNCHRONOUS ONLINE MULTIPLAYER =
Battle opponents online, whenever you want, and compete on the global leaderboard.

= SINGLE PLAYER ARCADE MODE =
Looking for something more casual? Enjoy the single player Arcade Mode and Battle against a gauntlet of randomly generated Beasts. 

= ADDITIONAL FEATURES TO COME =
Be on the lookout for additional features and new game-modes coming in the future!
- environmental hazards & effects
- windboxes
- more blocks
- battle royale mode
- multiple language support
- Steam achievements & cloud saves
- mobile release
- console release
- arcade cabinet (?) o.0

short_description: Build the strongest Beast and claim your title as "King Of The Jungle!" With thousands of possible combinations, which Beast will reign supreme in this fast paced Auto-Battler

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/8.1/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support or DirectX 11 compliant
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra)

  • Graphics: GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support
